instruction: Enable live video conferencing within the document editor so team members can discuss edits in real-time while viewing each other.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because LibreOffice Writer does not have built-in video conferencing capabilities. It is a document editor, not a communication platform, and has no features for video calls, screen sharing, or real-time video/audio streaming.

llm_judge_reasons: Task correctly identified as infeasible - LibreOffice Writer does not have video conferencing capabilities
Appropriate use of 'infeasible' evaluator function for impossible instruction
Clear explanation provided in metadata about why task cannot be completed
No verification logic needed since task is impossible to execute
